answers.q: How does it work, in 3-5 sentences?
answers.a: A reviewer clicks to start a Walkthrough. Junior runs a hidden Turn that uses a walkthrough skill to generate a story citing code by PR, file, side, and line range. Before storing, Junior re-reads every cited diff, file, and message to verify the citations resolve and are accurate. The model submits the story through a submit tool that rejects bad citations, and the document is stored with the verified excerpts.
